Alder Peak Robotics, Inc.
Offer of Employment

Dear Jordan Vale,

We are pleased to offer you the position of Staff Engineer. Your annual base salary will be $168,000 per year, paid semi-monthly.
You will be eligible for a target bonus of $12,000 per year, based on company and individual performance.
You will also receive a signing bonus of $10,000. If you leave within 12 months, you agree to repay the signing bonus.
Your expected start date is January 12, 2027.
Subject to approval by the Board of Directors, Alder Peak Robotics will recommend that you be granted an option to purchase 40,000 shares of common stock under the 2024 Equity Incentive Plan.
The exercise price per share will be $1.85, the fair market value on the grant date.
Vesting will occur over four years, with a one-year cliff, and continue in equal monthly installments after the cliff.
This offer is contingent on your signing the Confidential Information and Invention Assignment Agreement.
Your employment is at-will.

Accepted and agreed:
Signature: ______________________   Date: ______________
